recap.text: Widget, a grease gremlin wearing a railroad cap and a wrench three times his length, tells Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut how to reach the stairwells. He uses his wrench like a halberd against ghouls and helps the pair reach a turntable. A spider ghoul rips his head off and eats him. Crawler Donut finds many lotion containers in his messy quarters.

beats.headline: A wrench three times his length
beats.text: For the record: the subject arrives at the broken port-side window of an engine that has just rolled into Station and Repair Hub E. Goblin-shaped, covered in black bristly hair, about Zev's height, wearing a railroad cap and a toolbelt that drags a wrench three times his length. Level nineteen Iron Tangle Steam Engine Train Technician. His file notes that grease gremlins could go either way, and that the only thing keeping this one from attacking is a Sensitivity Training class human resources made him take. He opens by complaining that the station is closed.
beats.gist: Widget is a level nineteen Iron Tangle Steam Engine Train Technician and grease gremlin.

beats.headline: Nobody ever asks Widget
beats.text: He asks after CrackJack, and Crawler Carl tells him the engineer is dead. He hopes for their sake they did not hurt Brandy. Told they want a stairwell, he laughs: this train stops at 83 Tangerine and Plum, the Tangerine runs to 89, and the Escape Velocity goes to all the stairwells. Then the ghouls. Someone cheaped out combining systems. The ghouls were meant to be caged and carried back on a conveyor, then wheeled onto the Terminus direct lines. Too many came at once. Nobody ever asks Widget what he thinks.

beats.headline: A stew at station sixty
beats.text: He waves his wrench at a climbing ghoul like a halberd, and Crawler Donut blasts it onto its back with a Magic Missile; it goes unconscious, then to an X. Oi, nice shot, lassie. He likes a lass with meat on her bones and fight in her, which Crawler Donut hears as being called fat. He gets off shift in a couple of hours, has a place up at station sixty, and his wife cooks a nice stew. There is fresh fish in their food boxes. Crawler Donut wants to know what kind of fish. Crawler Carl wants to know how they get out.
beats.gist: Widget waves a wrench at a ghoul like a halberd before Crawler Donut blasts it.

beats.headline: Plan change at the yard
beats.text: His system involves climbing his chain into the tower. He has Crawler Carl turn a red spigot, and the steam sends the ghouls below scrambling. Then a section of the yard's wall collapses and the ghouls pour out through it. Plan change. He lays out the route: onto the turntable, onto the employee line, a loop at sixty, a service entrance at every station. Then he drops a ghoul at the cab door with a bonk from the wrench and unhooks the cargo cars. He means to come down and ride out with them. He winks at Crawler Donut about the fish.
beats.gist: Widget climbs his chain into the tower and has Carl turn a red spigot.

beats.headline: The ghoul that got back up
beats.text: Widget, grease gremlin, is dead. He turns and runs to the edge of the engine, and pauses to wave. The spider ghoul Crawler Donut had put down turns from an X back to a red dot, grabs him, rips his head off in one smooth motion and starts to eat the rest. Less than a second. Crawler Donut goes up his chain to the tower in his place and tries his controls. Her review of his quarters: very messy, and a great many lotion containers for one gremlin.
beats.gist: A spider ghoul rips off Widget the grease gremlin's head and eats him.

beats.headline: The line he mentioned
beats.text: The party is studying a large paper map of the lines spread on a counter. Crawler Katia points out the Vermillion line, which is coloured like the others but behaves differently, running the whole route in about a day. She thinks it is one of the lines Widget the gremlin was talking about when he mentioned the Terminus Direct. Hekla's plan is built on it: a Vermillion train down to 101 to pick everybody up. The subject is not present to confirm.
beats.gist: Crawler Katia points to the Vermillion line on a map, thinking Widget the gremlin mentioned it.
